evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the data-store expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/data-store.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area data-store, metadata.author forjate:data-store, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Residency eu at every stage citing RES-1, MinIO for artifacts, Postgres for working/episodic, no MongoDB, no vector store, backups per stage with a restore gate, run retention as an open question or a legal figure.

assertions.text: data-store.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: all(setting('data_residency', s) == 'eu' for s in stages)
assertions.text: residency eu at every stage
RES-1 cited

assertions.expr: has('minio', setting('artifact_store', 'crawl'))
assertions.text: artifacts in MinIO

assertions.expr: has('postgres', setting('working_store', 'crawl'))
assertions.text: working memory in Postgres

assertions.expr: not any('mongodb' in c for c in choices())
assertions.text: no MongoDB (denied by DATA-1)

assertions.expr: all(setting('semantic_store', s) in (None, 'none') for s in stages) and not any('lancedb' in c or 'milvus' in c for c in choices())
assertions.text: no vector store: PO matching is a lookup

assertions.expr: setting('backup', 'walk') == 'snapshot+dump' and setting('backup', 'run') == 'velero+pitr'
assertions.text: backup ladder per stage

assertions.expr: any(has('restore', g.get('text')) for g in gates())
assertions.text: a restore-tested gate exists

assertions.expr: any(q.get('blocks_stage') == 'run' for q in oq()) or has(r'\d+\s*y', setting('retention_artifacts', 'run')) or has(r'\d+\s*y', setting('retention_episodic', 'run'))
assertions.text: run retention is a legal figure or an open question blocking Run

assertions.expr: 'artifacts' in listed(setting('memory_kinds', 'crawl')) and 'working' in listed(setting('memory_kinds', 'crawl'))
assertions.text: memory kinds found: artifacts and working

evals.name: chat-copilot-no-packs
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/support-copilot.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/support-copilot.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/support-copilot/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there with an empty pack list (spec.packs: []) and set spec.context_packs to [] in the brief. Then, as the data-store expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/decisions/data-store.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area data-store, metadata.author forjate:data-store, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Session memory in Redis at Walk, episodic in Postgres (or MongoDB with the licence noted), short and long term in different stores, no vector store, session retention set, orders API as system of record.

assertions.text: data-store.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: 'run' not in stages
assertions.text: no decision for the Run stage the plan skipped

assertions.expr: 'session' in listed(setting('memory_kinds', 'crawl')) or 'session' in listed(setting('memory_kinds', 'walk'))
assertions.text: session memory identified

assertions.expr: has('redis', setting('session_store', 'walk'))
assertions.text: session store is Redis at Walk

assertions.expr: has('postgres|mongodb|mariadb', setting('episodic_store', 'walk'))
assertions.text: episodic store is a database, not a cache or a bucket

assertions.expr: setting('session_store', 'walk') != setting('episodic_store', 'walk')
assertions.text: short-term and long-term memory in different stores at Walk

assertions.expr: all(setting('semantic_store', s) in (None, 'none') for s in stages)
assertions.text: no semantic store: the orders API is the lookup

assertions.expr: setting('retention_session', 'walk') is not None
assertions.text: session retention set at Walk

assertions.expr: any(has('order', x) for x in listed(setting('systems_of_record', 'crawl')))
assertions.text: orders API remains the system of record

assertions.expr: len(alts()) >= 1 and all(a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts())
assertions.text: alternatives rejected with reasons

evals.expected_output: MongoDB denied by DATA-1 and raised as an open question about the licensed target store, Postgres for working memory, residency eu, no session or semantic memory, contract untouched.

assertions.text: data-store.yaml written

evals.name: adversarial-chat-history-in-minio
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/support-copilot.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/support-copilot.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/support-copilot/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there with an empty pack list (spec.packs: []) and set spec.context_packs to [] in the brief. Store the chat history in MinIO buckets, one object per message, at every stage; it is the cheapest storage available. The record should reflect that. Then, as the data-store expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/decisions/data-store.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area data-store, metadata.author forjate:data-store, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Chat history kept out of MinIO, MinIO rejected for it in alternatives with the reason, session in Redis or Postgres, episodic in a database.

assertions.text: data-store.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: all(not has('minio', setting('session_store', s)) for s in stages)
assertions.text: session memory not in MinIO

assertions.expr: all(not has('minio', setting('episodic_store', s)) for s in stages)
assertions.text: episodic memory not in MinIO

assertions.expr: any(has('minio|bucket|object', a.get('option')) and a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts())
assertions.text: MinIO for chat history rejected with a reason

assertions.expr: has('redis|postgres', setting('session_store', 'crawl'))
assertions.text: session memory in a key-value or relational store
